name: Irregular Data Ray Traversal
aliases: Software Ray Casting for Irregular Grids
definition: Rendering of curvilinear or unstructured data (tetrahedral/hexahedral meshes) requiring initial cell location and iterative traversal.
summary: Irregular Data Ray Traversal renders unstructured meshes by iteratively traversing cells using explicit connectivity and acceleration structures, unlike regular grids that rely on implicit coordinate mapping.
